**Why `/v1/chat/completions` ignores a request-time `num_ctx`:**

**Documented workaround:**
Create a Modelfile that pins the desired context window, e.g.:

```
FROM <base-model>
PARAMETER num_ctx 32768
```

Then run `ollama create mymodel -f Modelfile` and call the API using `"mymodel"` instead of the base model name. The derived model shares the original weights (no extra disk cost) and always serves requests at the pinned context length.
